body.message:
As mentioned earlier, cleaning is not included in the rate. External cleaning teams cannot be allowed in Holiday Homes, but the reception team will be happy to assist you if you need any cleaning during your stay.

Regarding your question about the specific deduction date, we just want to clarify so we can assist you correctly. Could you please let us know if you mean choosing a preferred date for monthly payments or if this is about last-minute cancellations?

We appreciate your understanding and look forward to your reply.
